description: Supabase phone sign-in without Twilio: connect the Supabase Send SMS hook to the selected SANDBOX project, so Supabase sends its login codes through Telmian. Returns the hook URL and signing secret once: set them in Supabase (Authentication > Hooks > Send SMS hook, type HTTPS) or, for local Supabase, in supabase/config.toml under [auth.hook.send_sms] (enabled = true, uri, secrets); never in client code. If the human already generated a secret in Supabase, pass it as secret. Live projects are connected by the human in the panel (Connections > Integrations). If the project is already connected, the existing hook is returned without a secret: pass rotate:true only to replace the secret (the old one stops working in Supabase at once).
name: setup_supabase_sms
